messages:
alex.k: Heads-up: bringing v3-ranker into the eval harness and seeing NDCG@10 drop ~3.9% on our holdout. MRR@10 oddly up ~1.2%. https://internal/redwood/evals/3112233445 :thinking_face:

maria.l: :eyes: can you paste the bucketed breakdown (short / mid / long queries) and whether candidate pools changed?

alex.k: quick paste: 
short (<=3 toks): NDCG +0.5%, MRR +4.1%
mid (4-20): NDCG -5.2%, MRR -0.8%
long (>20): NDCG -6.8%, MRR -2.4%
Also noticed a weird spike in identical-snippet duplicates in topk for mids.

jyoti: Did preprocessing change between baseline and v3? html-snippet handling or dedupe rules can do that.

alex.k: I diffed the pipeline config and found this change in the onboarding branch:
```
- preprocess.strip_html = true
+ preprocess.strip_html = false  # keep snippet boundaries for downstream features
```
That could increase context tokens that match short/mid queries.

samir: That would explain mid/long NDCG regression if reranker overweights snippet anchors. Two quick asks: rerun eval with canonicalized docs (strip_html=true) and rerun without quantization (fp16) to isolate quant sensitivity.

alex.k: Kicked off two runs: run/3112233445-canon-fp16 and run/3112233445-canon-int8-ptq. I also recorded the original run id.

eval-bot: Results posted:
- run/3112233445-canon-fp16: NDCG delta vs baseline -0.4% (much smaller)
- run/3112233445-canon-int8-ptq: NDCG delta vs baseline -1.8%
Details: https://internal/evals/3112233445/results

maria.l: int8 still worse => quantization amplifies the remaining signal mismatch. Could be attention scaling or per-head quant noise on snippet tokens.

jyoti: Also confirm candidate ordering coming into reranker. If the bi-encoder topk shifted (more near-ties), reranker sees a different candidate mix and metrics change even with same scorer. Any score histograms?

alex.k: Pulled candidate histograms — mid queries show more near-ties (bi-encoder score variance down). Short queries got little change. I can freeze the candidate set from baseline and rerun reranker-only eval to separate candidate-vs-reranker effects.

samir: Yes please. Suggested plan: 1) freeze baseline topk candidates per query and rerun reranker; 2) include strip_html ablation; 3) try per-channel int8 calibration (if available) and a fallback fp16 rollout.

alex.k: Queued jobs: job/3112233445-freezecandidates, job/3112233445-striphtml-ablation, job/3112233445-int8-calib. eval-bot scheduled them.

eval-bot: Jobs scheduled. Will post when finished.

alex.k: If strip_html fixes >90% of the delta we'll add explicit doc-normalization to the onboarding checklist and a small harness test for 'has_html_snippet' bucket.

maria.l: Agreed. Also add a quant-sensitivity smoke to the onboarding doc (fp16 vs int8 on a 2k query probe).

eval-bot: Noted: onboarding-checklist updated: add 'doc_normalization' and 'quant_smoke_test' items.

alex.k: Thanks — will follow up with final numbers. :thumbsup:
